assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone pixel-art illustration for the existing Soup ML training app.
Reference image role: the attached Kazakh ram-horn ornament defines Soup's pixel geometry and terracotta palette only. Generate a NEW object, not a screenshot or a copy of the reference.
Art direction for a coherent three-asset set: restrained premium pixel art, approximately a 64x64 logical pixel grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor-looking hard stair-step contours, compact centered object, flat solid colors, minimal one-pixel-level shading. Same palette throughout: terracotta #C0512D, dark brown #713822, warm peach #E5AE83, parchment #F4DEC2, muted ochre #8C6C49. Use terracotta outlines so the object reads on BOTH white and near-black backgrounds. Kazakh koshkar-muiz double-ram-horn motifs must be geometric, small, angular and readable as ornament, not random dots.
Output ONE square PNG with genuine alpha transparency. Object fills about 75% of the square, all tips contained, balanced modest transparent padding. No background color, no black rectangle, no ground plane, no shadows outside the object, no checkerboard baked in. No text or letters, no watermark, no frame, no 3D rendering, no photography, no blur, no smooth gradients, no glow, no surrounding UI. Readable when displayed at 80 to 128 CSS pixels.
Subject: one Kazakh piala, a traditional handleless shallow hemispherical ceramic soup bowl filled with warm amber sorpa. Front-facing with a slightly visible oval opening, short foot, terracotta ceramic body. A cream decorative band across the bowl carries a carefully mirrored small Kazakh double ram-horn motif in terracotta. Three short angular pixel wisps of steam above it, colored warm terracotta/peach so they remain visible on light and dark UI. Quiet, welcoming, clearly a soup bowl. No saucer, no spoon, no food toppings, no extra objects.

Subject: one small upright recipe sheet made from warm cream parchment, mostly front-facing with a tiny folded top-right corner. Its narrow top border carries a terracotta mirrored Kazakh ram-horn ornament. Below the ornament are three restrained rows of abstract pixel marks suggesting ingredients and preparation lines: short blocks only, NOT legible letters and NOT fake writing. A tiny terracotta piala pictogram near the lower edge gives a soup-recipe association. Flat angular pixel outline, few dark terracotta shadows inside the sheet only. No pen, ribbon, seal, table, utensils or extra objects.

Subject: one traditional copper soup ladle, with the round deep scoop toward the lower-left and its long slender handle extending diagonally to the upper-right. A compact geometric Kazakh ram-horn motif decorates the handle grip in cream and terracotta. Copper in Soup's terracotta palette, a peach highlight inside the scoop, a darker pixel edge defining its depth. The ladle silhouette must be unmistakable and fit entirely within the canvas.
